proposals.before: Prince Chen Cheng Xun was Gaozu's youngest son.
proposals.after: Prince of Chen Cheng Xun was Gaozu's youngest son.
proposals.reason: 承勛 (Chengxūn) is a different personal name from 承訓 (Chengxùn); English should distinguish 勛, and the title needs "of".

proposals.before: At the dynasty's founding he commanded the palace horse guard, served as honorary Grand Mentor and military governor of Yicheng, then was shifted to Xuzhou with the added titles of Grand Marshal and vice grand councilor.
proposals.after: At the dynasty's founding he commanded the palace horse guard, served as honorary Grand Mentor and military governor of Yicheng, then was shifted to Xu Prefecture with the added titles of Grand Marshal and vice grand councilor.
proposals.reason: 許州 is Xu Prefecture, not 徐州 Xuzhou used later in the chapter.

proposals.before: Not long after, the Dazhou garrison mutinied; Wang Jun sent the former Shen prefect Ma Duo to inspect the prefecture, and Duo marched into the city—whereupon Xin, distraught, took his own life.
proposals.after: Not long after, the Chanzhou garrison mutinied; Wang Jun sent the former Shen prefect Ma Duo to inspect the prefecture, and Duo marched into the city—whereupon Xin, distraught, took his own life.
proposals.reason: 澶州 is Chanzhou, not Dazhou.

proposals.before: Before long there was a mutiny in the army at Dazhou; Wang Jun sent the former prefect of Shenzhou Ma Duo to lead troops to the prefecture on an inspection tour, and Duo led his army into the city; Xin, in panic and confusion, killed himself.
proposals.after: Before long there was a mutiny in the army at Chanzhou; Wang Jun sent the former prefect of Shenzhou Ma Duo to lead troops to the prefecture on an inspection tour, and Duo led his army into the city; Xin, in panic and confusion, killed himself.
proposals.reason: 澶州 is Chanzhou, not Dazhou.

proposals.before: Yun reached Songzhou while Wei had already been carried back to the capital from Dazhou by his troops.
proposals.after: Yun reached Songzhou while Wei had already been carried back to the capital from Chanzhou by his troops.
proposals.reason: 澶州 is Chanzhou, not Dazhou.

proposals.before: When Yun reached Songzhou, Wei had already been escorted back to the capital from Dazhou by the soldiers.
proposals.after: When Yun reached Songzhou, Wei had already been escorted back to the capital from Chanzhou by the soldiers.
proposals.reason: 澶州 is Chanzhou, not Dazhou.

proposals.before: At Songzhou, Yun climbed a tower and asked why Chongwei had come; Chongwei said, "The Dazhou garrison mutinied—we feared you had not heard and sent me to guard you, not to harm you."
proposals.after: At Songzhou, Yun climbed a tower and asked why Chongwei had come; Chongwei said, "The Chanzhou garrison mutinied—we feared you had not heard and sent me to guard you, not to harm you."
proposals.reason: 澶州 is Chanzhou, not Dazhou.

proposals.before: When Chongwei reached Songzhou, Yun ascended a tower and asked the purpose of Chongwei's coming; Chongwei said: "There was a mutiny in the army at Dazhou; fearing you had not grasped it, they sent Chongwei to guard you—there is no ill intent."
proposals.after: When Chongwei reached Songzhou, Yun ascended a tower and asked the purpose of Chongwei's coming; Chongwei said: "There was a mutiny in the army at Chanzhou; fearing you had not grasped it, they sent Chongwei to guard you—there is no ill intent."
proposals.reason: 澶州 is Chanzhou, not Dazhou.

decisions.after: Cheng Xun, Prince of Chen, was Gaozu's youngest son.
decisions.reason: Focus unit 陳王承勛 needs the title Prince of Chen; the prior 'Prince Chen' misrenders 陳王. The proposed 'Prince of Chen Cheng Xun' is awkward and still runs title into the personal name; the chapter's own pattern (e.g. 'Duke of Xiangyin, Yun') separates them. The after also leaves 'Cheng Xun' unchanged, so it does not carry out the claimed 勛/訓 romanization fix.
Focus unit has 移鎮許州; 許州 is Xu Prefecture and must not be rendered as Xuzhou (徐州), which appears elsewhere in the chapter. The proposed replacement correctly distinguishes the place.
Focus unit has 澶州軍變; 澶州 is Chanzhou, not Dazhou. The proposed idiomatic fix restores the correct place name.
Same focus unit 澶州軍變; the literal 'Dazhou' is a mistranslation of 澶州. Chanzhou is the correct reading.
Focus unit 自澶州 again names Chanzhou; idiomatic 'Dazhou' is wrong. The proposed Chanzhou reading matches the Chinese.
Literal likewise misrenders 澶州 as Dazhou in 自澶州; Chanzhou is correct.
Chongwei's speech cites 澶州軍變; idiomatic 'Dazhou' invents the wrong place. Chanzhou restores the source.
Literal speech likewise has 澶州軍變 misread as Dazhou; Chanzhou is the accurate place name.
